verdict.rationale: Recruitee is a SaaS applicant-tracking system, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions one. The REST API with bearer tokens, the llms.txt file and the markdown versions of doc pages are developer and AI-readability building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
